=== REFERENCES ===

Use the provided Riven reference for visual continuity.

Use Riven's weapon exactly as shown in the provided reference.
Do not redesign or alter the weapon.

Use the provided Burning Settlement reference
for the environment.

Use the provided Mysterious Dark Figure reference
for the dark figure.

Maintain the same burning settlement:
wooden buildings on fire,
heavy smoke,
orange firelight,
ash and embers drifting through the air.


=== TECHNICAL ===

16:9 cinematic live-action dark fantasy.

Grounded photorealistic realism.

Fast, physical, readable combat.

Realistic body weight and impact.

Dynamic but controlled cinematic camera movement.

Natural fire, footsteps, weapon impacts,
breathing, wind, and environmental sound.

No dialogue.
No subtitles.
No background music.

Keep Riven's weapon exactly consistent
with the provided reference.

Use only THREE major cinematic shots.


=== VIDEO SUMMARY ===

Riven and the Mysterious Dark Figure
are facing each other across the burning road.

The figure suddenly attacks first,
rushing toward Riven with unnatural speed.

Riven reacts in time and blocks the attack.

She immediately fights back,
using controlled skill and quick counters.

Riven successfully lands a strong strike
against the dark figure.

But the struck part of its body
briefly distorts into smoke-like darkness
and reforms almost immediately.

Riven realizes her attack barely affected it.

The figure becomes faster and more aggressive.

Riven is gradually forced onto the defensive,
but she remains standing.

The scene ends after Riven survives
another powerful clash.

The fight continues.


=== SHOT 1 — FIRST CLASH ===

Open on a new medium side angle of Riven.

Do not repeat the exact previous wide composition.

Riven is already focused on
the Mysterious Dark Figure ahead.

She grips her weapon firmly.

For a brief moment,
both remain still.


Then—

the Mysterious Dark Figure suddenly rushes toward Riven.

It does not run like a normal person.

Its dark body surges rapidly through the smoke,
almost like a fast moving shadow.

The attack is sudden and extremely fast.


Riven reacts immediately.

She turns and raises her weapon.

BLOCK.


A powerful impact between them.

Riven is pushed backward by the force,
her boots sliding across the dirt.

But she stays on her feet.

She regains her balance immediately.

The figure remains close.

The fight has begun.


=== SHOT 2 — RIVEN FIGHTS BACK ===

The Mysterious Dark Figure attacks again.

Riven is ready this time.

Keep the exchange fast but readable.

Riven avoids one attack,
repositions,
and immediately counters.

She fights with controlled skill and experience.

Do not create a long complicated combo.


The figure moves past her.

Riven quickly turns with it.

She sees an opening.

Riven delivers one strong,
committed strike with her weapon.


THE STRIKE CONNECTS.


For a brief moment,
the dark figure's body distorts
where Riven struck it.

The dark material breaks apart
into smoke-like shadow.

No blood.

No gore.

No explosion.


Riven watches closely.


The distorted darkness quickly gathers again.

The figure reforms.

It remains standing.


Riven realizes the strike
barely affected it.

Hold her reaction only briefly.

She has no time to think.


=== SHOT 3 — THE PRESSURE CHANGES ===

The Mysterious Dark Figure immediately attacks again.

This time it becomes faster.

A dark blur rushes across Riven's position.

Riven turns and blocks.

IMPACT.


The figure changes direction rapidly
through the smoke.

Riven avoids another attack.

It comes from another direction.

Riven blocks again.


The rhythm of the fight has changed.

Earlier,
Riven could counterattack.

Now she is increasingly forced to defend.


Keep the action simple and readable:

the figure rushes,

Riven reacts,

Riven blocks or avoids it,

the figure immediately changes direction.


Riven remains skilled.

She is not helpless.

But the figure is becoming
too fast and too powerful.


Finally—

the dark figure rushes directly toward her again.

Riven plants her feet
and raises her weapon with both hands.


A HEAVY IMPACT.


Riven is pushed backward across the ground.

Her boots slide through the dirt.

She struggles against the force—

but manages to stop herself.


Riven remains standing.

She breathes heavily.

Her weapon remains firmly in her hands.


Across from her,
the Mysterious Dark Figure
stands within the drifting smoke.

Neither attacks for a brief moment.


Riven looks at it.

The figure looks back.


CUT.


=== END STATE ===

Riven has successfully defended herself
against the first attacks.

She fought back and landed a direct strike.

Her attack barely affected
the Mysterious Dark Figure.

The figure has begun moving faster
and forcing Riven onto the defensive.

Riven is still standing
and still holding her weapon.

The fight is not over.

CUT.

input_box_content.user_input_content:
=== REFERENCES ===

Use the provided Riven reference for visual continuity.

Use Riven's weapon exactly as shown in the provided reference.
Do not redesign or alter the weapon.

Use the provided Burning Settlement reference
for the environment.

Use the provided Mysterious Dark Figure reference
for the dark figure.

Maintain the same burning settlement:
wooden buildings on fire,
heavy smoke,
orange firelight,
ash and embers drifting through the air.


=== TECHNICAL ===

16:9 cinematic live-action dark fantasy.

Grounded photorealistic realism.

Fast, physical, readable combat.

Realistic body weight and impact.

Dynamic but controlled cinematic camera movement.

Natural fire, footsteps, weapon impacts,
breathing, wind, and environmental sound.

No dialogue.
No subtitles.
No background music.

Keep Riven's weapon exactly consistent
with the provided reference.

Use only THREE major cinematic shots.


=== VIDEO SUMMARY ===

Riven and the Mysterious Dark Figure
are facing each other across the burning road.

The figure suddenly attacks first,
rushing toward Riven with unnatural speed.

Riven reacts in time and blocks the attack.

She immediately fights back,
using controlled skill and quick counters.

Riven successfully lands a strong strike
against the dark figure.

But the struck part of its body
briefly distorts into smoke-like darkness
and reforms almost immediately.

Riven realizes her attack barely affected it.

The figure becomes faster and more aggressive.

Riven is gradually forced onto the defensive,
but she remains standing.

The scene ends after Riven survives
another powerful clash.

The fight continues.


=== SHOT 1 — FIRST CLASH ===

Open on a new medium side angle of Riven.

Do not repeat the exact previous wide composition.

Riven is already focused on
the Mysterious Dark Figure ahead.

She grips her weapon firmly.

For a brief moment,
both remain still.


Then—

the Mysterious Dark Figure suddenly rushes toward Riven.

It does not run like a normal person.

Its dark body surges rapidly through the smoke,
almost like a fast moving shadow.

The attack is sudden and extremely fast.


Riven reacts immediately.

She turns and raises her weapon.

BLOCK.


A powerful impact between them.

Riven is pushed backward by the force,
her boots sliding across the dirt.

But she stays on her feet.

She regains her balance immediately.

The figure remains close.

The fight has begun.


=== SHOT 2 — RIVEN FIGHTS BACK ===

The Mysterious Dark Figure attacks again.

Riven is ready this time.

Keep the exchange fast but readable.

Riven avoids one attack,
repositions,
and immediately counters.

She fights with controlled skill and experience.

Do not create a long complicated combo.


The figure moves past her.

Riven quickly turns with it.

She sees an opening.

Riven delivers one strong,
committed strike with her weapon.


THE STRIKE CONNECTS.


For a brief moment,
the dark figure's body distorts
where Riven struck it.

The dark material breaks apart
into smoke-like shadow.

No blood.

No gore.

No explosion.


Riven watches closely.


The distorted darkness quickly gathers again.

The figure reforms.

It remains standing.


Riven realizes the strike
barely affected it.

Hold her reaction only briefly.

She has no time to think.


=== SHOT 3 — THE PRESSURE CHANGES ===

The Mysterious Dark Figure immediately attacks again.

This time it becomes faster.

A dark blur rushes across Riven's position.

Riven turns and blocks.

IMPACT.


The figure changes direction rapidly
through the smoke.

Riven avoids another attack.

It comes from another direction.

Riven blocks again.


The rhythm of the fight has changed.

Earlier,
Riven could counterattack.

Now she is increasingly forced to defend.


Keep the action simple and readable:

the figure rushes,

Riven reacts,

Riven blocks or avoids it,

the figure immediately changes direction.


Riven remains skilled.

She is not helpless.

But the figure is becoming
too fast and too powerful.


Finally—

the dark figure rushes directly toward her again.

Riven plants her feet
and raises her weapon with both hands.


A HEAVY IMPACT.


Riven is pushed backward across the ground.

Her boots slide through the dirt.

She struggles against the force—

but manages to stop herself.


Riven remains standing.

She breathes heavily.

Her weapon remains firmly in her hands.


Across from her,
the Mysterious Dark Figure
stands within the drifting smoke.

Neither attacks for a brief moment.


Riven looks at it.

The figure looks back.


CUT.


=== END STATE ===

Riven has successfully defended herself
against the first attacks.

She fought back and landed a direct strike.

Her attack barely affected
the Mysterious Dark Figure.

The figure has begun moving faster
and forcing Riven onto the defensive.

Riven is still standing
and still holding her weapon.

The fight is not over.

CUT.
